_comment: Shared golden allow rule for decoration ports. tools/noise-golden/make_feature_datapack.js and crates/rine-worldgen/tests/feature_golden.rs both read this file. A top-level placed feature is allowed when its placement types are in placements (biome only at top level) and its configured feature is in types, recursively for every nested placed feature of a selector or sequence.
_predicates_comment: Block predicate types that the port evaluates. A predicate of a block_predicate_filter placement or of a block_column allowed_placement must use only these types (recursively through predicate/predicates).
_simple_blocks_comment: Blocks the simple_block port classifies (vegetation.rs kind_of_name). A simple_block state provider and a would_survive predicate may only name these.
